subject: Invoicing timeline and minimum-commit amendment
messages:
From: Elena Morales <procurement@cloudlytics.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: AcctsPayable@cloudlytics.com
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on Order Form: invoicing timing & min commit

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about the performance numbers. We're reviewing the Order Form you shared (attached: CF_OrderForm_v1.pdf). A couple of items procurement needs clarified before we can route to Legal & Finance: 

- Net payment terms: is Redwood able to accommodate Net 30? The template shows Net 45/60 possibilities.
- Minimum commit language: can we reduce Q3 minimums to accommodate our ramp? Current schedule has a 3-month up-front minimum that is heavy for our expected usage.
- Invoicing & tax: invoices should be issued to AcctsPayable@cloudlytics.com; please confirm your VAT registration and if Redwood will itemize taxes on invoices.

We'd prefer to keep this moving this week — can you loop in finance/legal and share a suggested amendment? I can provide a PO (I have PO #4532 ready).

Best,
Elena Morales
Procurement Manager
Cloudlytics, Inc.

Attachment: CF_OrderForm_v1.pdf (order form sent by Redwood)

From: michael_grant@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <procurement@cloudlytics.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Order Form: invoicing timing & min commit

Hi Elena — thanks, and great to hear you're moving this along.

Quick answers up front: we can be flexible on the minimum commit for Q3 (need to align on thresholds), and we typically support Net 30 for customers of your size — I'll confirm with Finance. Redwood will itemize applicable taxes on invoices; for VAT/withholding we do follow local tax law and list taxes line-by-line.

Next steps I propose:
- Stephanie (cc) to confirm the billing cadence and confirm Net 30 vs Net 45 for this deal.
- Kimberly (cc) to review tax/withholding language and confirm whether the MSA needs a specific carve-out for Cloudlytics' country of registration.
- I'll prepare a short amendment (redline) to the attached Order Form and check-in with you on the exact Q3 minimum number you want.

I'm attaching an initial redline I drafted (Redline_OrderForm_06152026.pdf) — it's light touch and keeps the MSA intact. Would you be available for a quick 20-min sync today or tomorrow?

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redline_OrderForm_06152026.pdf

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: michael_grant@redwood.com, Elena Morales <procurement@cloudlytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Order Form: invoicing timing & min commit

Elena / Michael — FYI from Finance: Net 30 is acceptable for Cloudlytics provided they issue a PO against the final order and we have standard KYC completed. A couple of operational items: 

- Invoicing cadence: Redwood issues monthly invoices in arrears by default. If you'd prefer quarterly invoicing we can do that with a minimum invoice threshold (to avoid micro invoices).
- PO: please confirm the PO number on first invoice (you mentioned #4532).
- Taxes: we will itemize taxes on the invoice. If Cloudlytics is VAT-registered and provides a VAT ID, we can zero-rate where local law permits (we'll need exemption docs).

Attached is a suggested invoice cadence template to align dates and remittance instructions.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Revenue Operations & Billing
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Invoice_Schedule_Template.xlsx

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: michael_grant@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, Elena Morales <procurement@cloudlytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Order Form: invoicing timing & min commit

Hi all — quick legal take after reviewing Michael's redline and the base MSA. Two items to flag: 

1) Tax & Withholding: Our standard MSA has the parties bear their own taxes, and Redwood will not gross-up for withholding unless explicitly negotiated. If Cloudlytics requires Redwood to gross-up or indemnify for withholding, that needs to be a negotiated MSA amendment — not an Order Form line.

2) Minimum Commitment language: the Order Form redline is fine to cap the commitment, but if you want to make the Q3 minimum contingent (e.g., "ramp provision" tying minimum to actual usage), that should be an Order Form addendum with explicit measurement and rollback terms.

I prepared an MSA redline with a short proposed paragraph for tax handling and a model amendment for a "ramp allowance." See attached (MSA_Redline_06172026.docx). If everyone is comfortable, we should incorporate the tax indemnity language into the MSA and keep the Order Form to commercial numbers.

Also — if you want this to go through DocuSign quickly, I can prepare the envelope once the final language is agreed.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MSA_Redline_06172026.docx

From: Elena Morales <procurement@cloudlytics.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-18T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Order Form: invoicing timing & min commit

Thanks Kimberly — that approach makes sense. A few confirmations from our side: 

- Net 30 is fine.
- PO #4532 is attached (Acme_PO_4532.pdf) and should be referenced on the first invoice.
- For Q3 we request the minimum commit be reduced by 40% for our ramp window with a predefined rollback to standard minimums starting Q4. Suggested language: "During the first billing quarter following execution, minimum committed units will be reduced to 60% of the standard commitment; thereafter standard commitments resume unless parties agree in writing."

We can accept tax language in the MSA as proposed, provided Cloudlytics provides VAT documentation if applicable.

Elena Morales
Procurement Manager
Cloudlytics, Inc.

Attachment: Acme_PO_4532.pdf

From: michael_grant@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <procurement@cloudlytics.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-18T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Order Form: invoicing timing & min commit — final steps

Elena — thanks, this is helpful and agreed in principle. Summary of agreed items and next steps: 

1) Payments & invoicing: Redwood will issue monthly invoices in arrears; first invoice will reference PO #4532. Finance confirms Net 30. (Stephanie to configure in billing system.)

2) Minimum commit: Redwood agrees to the Q3 ramp reduction to 60% of the standard commitment (language as Elena suggested). We'll schedule a follow-up to confirm the exact unit counts to bake into the Order Form amendment.

3) Tax/MSA: Legal will accept tax carve-out language into the MSA as drafted. Cloudlytics should provide VAT ID/exemption docs if applicable.

4) Signatures: I'll upload the Order Form Amendment and the MSA redline to DocuSign once Legal gives final sign-off. Link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/envelope/0A12B3C4D5E6F7

5) Ops: Stephanie, please confirm invoice calendar and whether Cloudlytics prefers monthly or quarterly invoices (they said monthly in the thread).

Attachments: OrderForm-Amendment-0618_redline.pdf

Kimberly — can you please prepare the DocuSign envelope and route to Elena once redlines are finalized?

Thanks all — happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

Regards,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
